metadata.notes: PR 3.4b smoke fixture. Verifies (a) the agent path runs without aborting on a minimal synthetic schema, (b) the projects.business_context field propagates from fixture metadata through synthetic-context-builder, (c) score remains 1.000 against the same gold as 001-fixture (no regression), (d) cache_read_input_tokens > 0 on iteration N>1. Gold is intentionally hand-authored (NOT model-generated) to avoid the synthetic-gold-labels trap (Phase A §E4).
metadata.business_context: Internal naming convention: the source field 'name' stores customer display strings in uppercase ('JOHN DOE') in the legacy CRM. The target system 'label' field is the canonical display column and expects mixed-case formatting ('John Doe'). When mapping name → label, a casing-normalization transform is required. The id field is a UUID on both sides; pass through unchanged.
